name: Ontario

bbox_source.dataset: Province (outer boundary of the Province of Ontario)
bbox_source.publisher: Government of Ontario (Office of the Surveyor General, via Ontario GeoHub)
bbox_source.method: Layer extent (NAD83) and the min/max of the polygon's vertices in EPSG:4326, which agree to 0.001°. See docs/regions-proposed.json.

includes: Local streets, buildings, terrain and crops, plus water, help and resource points

terrain.dataset: Medium Resolution Digital Elevation Model (MRDEM), 30 m digital terrain model – CanElevation Series
attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.

The organisations in charge of the Copernicus programme by law or by delegation do not incur any liability for any use of the Copernicus WorldDEM-30.
terrain.notes: Cloud-optimised GeoTIFFs in Canada Atlas Lambert (EPSG:3979), heights in CGVD2013. NRCan states the model is in part produced from Copernicus WorldDEM-30, so its notice is carried too. HRDEM (lidar) is already merged into MRDEM where it exists.

water.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Ontario.
water.notes: Lakes, ponds, reservoirs and wide rivers, with official names. The service names OGL – Ontario in its copyright text. #32 named the OHN Hydrographic Poly and Line records; those hold dams, rapids and falls, not lakes and rivers, so this layer and Watercourse are used instead.

water.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Ontario.
Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Ontario.
water.notes: Dam name and ownership type only.

crops.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
crops.notes: 30 m crop-type raster. Classes kept: orchards, other fruits, vineyards, berries, blueberry, cranberry, other berries.

buildings.dataset: The Open Database of Buildings (ODB), version 3
attribution: Adapted from Statistics Canada, The Open Database of Buildings, version 3. This does not constitute an endorsement by Statistics Canada of this product.
Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
buildings.notes: Compiled by Statistics Canada from many municipal and provincial sources; each source and its own licence is listed in ODB_v3_data_providers.csv inside the download. Only outlines and heights are kept, never names, addresses or other attributes.

buildings.attribution: Microsoft Canadian Building Footprints, under the Open Database License (ODbL).
buildings.notes: Optional fill-in: used only in zoom-14 cells where ODB has no building. The repository was archived on 8 October 2026.

buildings.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, under the Open Database License (ODbL).

places.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
© OpenStreetMap contributors, under the Open Database License (ODbL).
places.notes: Read from the region's roads file, as tools/build_places.py does for the US.

roads.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, under the Open Database License (ODbL).
roads.notes: Streets, land use, water lines and help points, by tools/build_map.py, as for Southern California. Extract by Geofabrik.

addresses.dataset: Overture Maps addresses theme (Canadian rows: Statistics Canada National Address Register)
addresses.attribution: Adapted from Statistics Canada, National Address Register. This does not constitute an endorsement by Statistics Canada of this product.
addresses.notes: Overture lists these rows under the Statistics Canada Open Licence; the open.canada.ca record for the register lists OGL – Canada.
